lines.text: Many learners say: Sorry for late.
For being! Sorry for being late.

native.hook: sorry for 后面要加 being！
native.tip: 中文说“抱歉迟到了”，“迟到”直接接在后面。英语 for 后面不能直接放 late，要加 being。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Sorry for late.”😅 中文里“迟到”可以直接接在后面，英语要加 being：“Sorry for being late.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Sorry for being late.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Late cannot follow for by itself. Add being.
en.caption: Do you say “Sorry for late.” 😅 Late cannot follow for by itself, so add being: “Sorry for being late.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
